items.title: Price of Anarchy of First-Price Auctions in Agentic Markets
items.summary: An agentic market is a decentralized serving-time market where AI agents bid to claim each user prompt. An agent's bid is based on its expected value for the prompt, which is the expectation of the reward for its response minus its inference costs.
